full_page.content:
Page 168 Cont.
Nov. 18 Virginia Debeaussaert and John Karn Expecting to be married soon. Mother was anxious.
18 Gertrude Purdo - 16 - wanted to go to dance. Father objected because Grandma was in hospital very sick .... Girl went into convulsions and was taken to same hospital is still speechless.
Mrs. Mary Milewski - 56 - Vericose and stomach
John Tighe - 54 - ..
Thanks. .. Richard Ring1 - 6 - had scarlet Fev., brights disease and pneumonia. Drs. had given up all hopes .... Mother Russian - Father had bragged that none of his family was sick ......... Boy's Aunt ..... zealous promoter of Ser. Mass Assoc'n was called and brought to Mon- astery .... Boy home - O.K.
Page 169 Nov. 19th J. W. Wall - 21 - Married Gale G. - 22 - non Cath. - without relig- ion Sept. 9th - She turns out seemingly without any real faith and both seem unhappy - Enrolled To-nite - mother promises to have "City of God" if ....
Thanks - (see Nov. 15) Eliz. Penn - 23 mo. - prayed for last Wed. (15th) lukemia improving ever since. Deo Gr.
Mrs. Eliz. Kengel - 75 - Two inward cancers - breast removed five yrs . ago.
20th Ralph Kingsley - 10 - lympho Sarcoma .... Sience baffled - Enrolled Today - Reading of City of God recomended
Francis Breloski - 72 - had operation on left eye and lost it and has been totally blind.
Louise Stocker - 52 - Very ill Drs. think it hopeless - vein & artery.
21 P.M. Mrs. Loretta Shaughnessy - 42 - blood poison in hand. Loss of arm feared. Enrolled To-day
Mrs. Anna Saile of Toledo - 67 - now in Ford Hosp. - pneumonia - ulcer in eye - Very threatening - Enrolled To-day $5.
